## A. Workspace facts

| Fact | Evidence |

| **Stack** | Next 15 App Router, React 19, Tailwind 4, AI SDK 6 (`ai` + `@ai-sdk/openai`), Zod, Recharts. Deps: `@db` workspace, `@repo/disclosure-ui`, unused `@knowledge-base` workspace dep (disk KB via [`apps/disclosure-lab/src/lib/knowledge-base.ts`](apps/disclosure-lab/src/lib/knowledge-base.ts) + [`paths.ts`](apps/disclosure-lab/src/lib/paths.ts)). |
| **Scripts** | App: `dev`/`build`/`start`/`lint`/`typecheck` in [`apps/disclosure-lab/package.json`](apps/disclosure-lab/package.json). Root: `dev:disclosure-lab`, `build:disclosure-lab` in root [`package.json`](package.json). Port **3010**. |
| **Env** | Cascade in [`apps/disclosure-lab/src/lib/db.ts`](apps/disclosure-lab/src/lib/db.ts) + [`next.config.ts`](apps/disclosure-lab/next.config.ts): repo `.env` → `.env.local` → `apps/app/.env.local` → `packages/db/.env` → optional `apps/disclosure-lab/.env.local` (override). Needs `DATABASE_URL`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_VECTOR_STORE_ID`. No app `.env*` present. |
| **Safety model** | Human confirm INSERT/UPDATE; DELETE/DDL blocked ([`write-policy.ts`](apps/disclosure-lab/src/lib/write-policy.ts)); assistant tools read-only ([`api/agent/route.ts`](apps/disclosure-lab/src/app/api/agent/route.ts)); audit `.data/audit.jsonl` (gitignored). **No auth** on `/api/confirm`, `/api/sql`, `/api/agent`, etc. |
| **Tracked** | 36 files under `apps/disclosure-lab/` in git. No tests, no eslint config, no prettier in this app. |
| **Nested agents/docs** | **None**: no `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `GOAL.md`, `.agents/`, `.claude/`, `.cursor/`. Spec: [`docs/plans/2026-08-09-disclosure-lab.md`](docs/plans/2026-08-09-disclosure-lab.md). Ledger: T-052 / DMGD-216 in [`docs/plans/TODO.md`](docs/plans/TODO.md). Claude agents exist for app/rag/UI only ([`.claude/agents/apps/`](.claude/agents/apps/)) — **no disclosure-lab agent**. |

---

## B. Real agent DX failures (this app)

1. **Stale “planned” canon** — [`CONTEXT-MAP.md`](CONTEXT-MAP.md), [`packages/db/CONTEXT.md`](packages/db/CONTEXT.md) still say “planned `apps/disclosure-lab`” while 36 files ship. Agents re-scaffold or skip.
2. **No workspace pin** — SessionStart dumps first 2k of `AGENTS.md` + `DAILY_WORK_PLAN.md` + `TODO.md` ([`.claude/settings.json`](.claude/settings.json)); lab has no nested `CLAUDE.md`/`GOAL.md` for lane-router to read.
3. **Live Neon + unauthenticated write APIs** — `/api/confirm` executes mutations with only a UUID token ([`api/confirm/route.ts`](apps/disclosure-lab/src/app/api/confirm/route.ts)). Claude Bash/curl against localhost:3010 bypasses “agent read-only” narrative.
4. **Env/MCP blind spot** — Claude [`.mcp.json`](.mcp.json) has no Neon; agents guess schema or poke gitignored `packages/db/.env`. Cursor already has Neon.
5. **Orphan hooks / missing guards** — [`block-new-docs.sh`](.claude/hooks/block-new-docs.sh) only in unused [`hooks.json`](.claude/hooks/hooks.json). Devin [`block-dangerous-git.sh`](.devin/skills/git-guardrails-claude-code/scripts/block-dangerous-git.sh) **omits `git stash`** (known 2026-07-12 shared-tree failure).
6. **DoD mismatch** — Lab is ops console; dogfood = `:3010` + confirm card + audit JSONL, not Research Canvas. No tests → green-CI theater easy.
7. **Dead dep signal** — `@knowledge-base` in package.json unused; agents may import the package instead of disk paths.

---

## C. Verdict on the 6 proposals (disclosure-lab only)

| # | Proposal | Verdict | Why |
|---|----------|---------|-----|
| 1 | MCP: Neon + Linear | **Keep Neon; Change Linear** | Neon is the lab’s primary surface. Linear = ticket hygiene (DMGD-216), not day-to-day schema work — optional here. |
| 2 | Skills: lane-router + dod-report | **Change** | lane-router needs a **nested** [`apps/disclosure-lab/CLAUDE.md`](apps/disclosure-lab) first (none exists). dod-report must specialize: confirm-token / audit / port 3010, not app DoD canvas. |
| 3 | Hooks: stash/reset/force-push; block-new-docs; protect .env/lockfiles | **Keep** (wire into `settings.json`) | Highest ROI for concurrent agents on shared tree; `.env` protection critical (`packages/db/.env` = live Neon). Fix script to deny `git stash`. |
| 4 | Subagents: dod-auditor + security-reviewer | **Change** | security-reviewer **high** value (unauth confirm/sql). dod-auditor only if lab-scoped checklist; generic DoD will false-fail. Do **not** add a sixth “lab expert” persona. |
| 5 | Plugins: security-guidance + typescript-lsp | **Keep security-guidance; Change LSP** | security-guidance matches write-API gap. typescript-lsp useful for small Next app but secondary to Neon MCP; no pyright needed. |
| 6 | DX: slim SessionStart; compact re-inject; worktrees; scoped prettier | **Keep slim SessionStart + compact; Drop worktrees-as-primary + Drop prettier for this app** | Slim + compact: Keep. Worktrees: nice globally, not lab-specific. Prettier: only [`apps/app/.prettierrc`](apps/app/.prettierrc) — lab has none; repo-wide prettier fights this package. |

---

## D. ≤2 better workspace-specific automations

1. **Nested lab pin** — `apps/disclosure-lab/CLAUDE.md` (+ optional `GOAL.md`): live Neon, human-confirm-only writes, agent no Bash mutations against `:3010` or `DATABASE_URL`, routes table, env cascade. Unblocks lane-router without repo-wide myth dumps.
2. **PreToolUse Bash guard for live DB** — deny patterns like `curl …/api/confirm`, `psql`/`neon` write SQL, or scripts that skip confirm when cwd/target is disclosure-lab / `packages/db/.env`. Complements (does not replace) in-app write-policy.

---

## E. Risks from repo-wide hooks

- **`block-new-docs.sh` allowlist** — blocks lab-local `*_PSUEDOCODE.md` / PascalCase docs if agents follow user doc rules; force edits into wrong living files.
- **`git stash`/`reset` deny on shared tree** — good default; can strand agents who need legitimate recovery unless worktrees are the escape hatch.
- **Protect lockfiles** — can block intentional `bun install` lock updates from Claude in monorepo.
- **SessionStart still noisy if not slimmed** — first 2k of [`TODO.md`](docs/plans/TODO.md) (~145KB file) still teaches “T-052 in progress / planned” skew; wastes context for a 36-file app.
- **Repo-wide prettier** — will reformat lab with `apps/app` style or fail; lab has no local config.
- **Over-broad security hooks** — may treat lab’s intentional “trusted single-operator, no auth” ([`README.md`](apps/disclosure-lab/README.md)) as a defect and fight the product model instead of documenting localhost-only constraint.

---

**Next:** Open [`apps/disclosure-lab/README.md`](apps/disclosure-lab/README.md) and decide whether to wire Neon MCP + nested `CLAUDE.md` before any repo-wide hook PR.
